items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And all the Youngs, of course, were still in the band. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh no! They was too young.

ctx.x: I don't know his name. See, these guys was in the band... They came after we left. Cootie, and he had another guy named Ralph (I forget his last name) -- he was playing trumpet.
And all the Youngs, of course, were still in the band. None of them left.
Oh no! They was too young.
